name: Virtuse 5.0
install: cd cloudflare-worker && npm ci && npm run build

terminals.name: static-site
terminals.description: Serves the static marketing site (all HTML pages, the four Layer 2 modules, and the generated programmatic-SEO pages) at http://localhost:8777. Open e.g. http://localhost:8777/index.html or http://localhost:8777/concierge.html.

terminals.name: worker-dev
terminals.description: Runs the newsletter Cloudflare Worker locally via wrangler dev at http://localhost:8787 (POST /subscribe, GET /unsubscribe). Request validation, CORS, honeypot, and routing work with no secrets; live Resend sends and real unsubscribe need RESEND_API_KEY / RESEND_SEGMENT_ID / RESEND_FROM_EMAIL / UNSUB_SECRET, which are deploy-time secrets set via `wrangler secret put` (or a gitignored .dev.vars for local link signing).
